micro1071_scope:
`sw_drought=3` has no SWAP5 MICRO runtime. This draft adds a call-local typed de Willigen evaluator and a B1.10 MvG point-conductivity adapter for the admitted MICRO01 table. It does not bind the production root sink.

Run 37420361646 passed O0/O2-identical focused tests. The corrected-table literal B1.11 nonlinear oracle matched four constant-K model/stress cases and one heterogeneous-head case within 2e-5 cm/d per node, with all three source checks true. A separate real MvG sampling and uptake smoke passed. Exact hashes, output and PR-merge execution are preserved in `docs/audits/evidence/PPA_MICRO02_STANDALONE_SOURCE_FINAL_REPLAY.json.gz`. Documentation source and strict MkDocs passed.

The initial oracle omitted the legacy module `iMicro=1` setup. Those apparent signed-sink/source-closure findings were invalid harness output, have been retracted, and are recorded as negative evidence. The successful nonlinear oracle leaves B1.11 unmodified except the disclosed MICRO01 dry-table correction and public test access.

Scope ceiling: standalone component only. Heterogeneous-horizon source mapping, one accepted runtime root sink, transaction/mass/restart qualification, de Jong van Lier and signed hydraulic lift remain open. Keep this PR draft and unmerged until the production interface and its gates are addressed.
